summary.ru: Княжество Сербия — балканское государство, основанное в результате Второго сербского восстания. Первоначально государство занимало территорию бывшего Белградского пашалыка, однако в 1831—1833 годах оно расширило свои границы на запад, восток и юг.
summary.en: The Principality of Serbia was an autonomous, later sovereign state in the Balkans that came into existence as a result of the Serbian Revolution. Its creation was negotiated first through an unwritten agreement between Miloš Obrenović, leader of the Second Serbian Uprising, and Ottoman official Marashli Pasha, followed by a series of decrees of the Sublime Porte in 1828–1833. Its de facto independence ensued in 1867, following the evacuation of the remaining Ottoman troops from the Belgrade Fortress and the country; its independence was recognized internationally in 1878 by the Treaty of Berlin.
